verdict.rationale: Solid's docs describe explicit, fine-grained reactivity (signals/stores) with automatic dependency tracking and 'only code that depends on state reruns' — a clear alternative to implicit two-way binding, and community comments confirm this fine-grained model is real and performant. However, hands-on community feedback flags real predictability pitfalls (destructuring losing reactivity, non-intuitive reactive system compared to alternatives like Svelte/Vue) that complicate tracing state changes in practice. Missing for 10: independent tooling/devtools evidence for tracing signal graphs, and resolution of the destructuring/reactivity-loss gotchas noted by users.
